why_not_configuration_level_selection: It remains a selector over the same parents and attacks the easier static level rather than producing a new scheduler; it is useful as a diagnostic baseline only.
why_not_stop_family_a_entirely: The contextual-selector hypothesis is closed, but Family-A still supplies certified oracle semantics, interpretable ESTF/WFS mechanisms, and measurable parent-envelope headroom that can seed a genuinely new portfolio policy.
